offering_description.value: Owns and operates upscale and casual restaurants, bars, nightclubs and catering venues, mainly in New York City, Las Vegas and Washington DC. Sells meals, beverages and event services directly to diners and event hosts, and also manages food service at certain government-run and casino venues.

primary_products.value: prepared meals; alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages

primary_services.value: restaurant dining; bar and nightclub operation; catering and events; food and beverage management for venues

customer_segment.value: B2C: restaurant, bar and nightclub patrons, tourists and local diners; B2B: corporate and private event hosts, casino and hotel partners; B2G: government-owned venues and parks where it operates food service under concession

end_markets.value: restaurants; hospitality; entertainment and nightlife; catering and events

revenue_model.value: product sales: food and beverage sold to diners at owned restaurants and bars; service fees: catering and event fees; commissions or management fees: fees for managing restaurants owned by others
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: leases and runs restaurants, bars and event venues, buying food and beverages and selling to consumers; retailer: sells prepared food and drinks directly to diners

geography_served.value: US regional: New York City, Las Vegas, Washington DC, Florida, Gulf Coast

specialization.value: related lines: restaurants, bars and nightclubs, catering and venue food service management

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated restaurants, bars, nightclubs and event spaces; online: reservations and online ordering via websites and third-party apps; direct sales: catering and private event bookings

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: liquor licensing, food safety, health codes, and labor and wage rules enforced by state and local authorities

notes: Current venue mix, locations and management contracts may have changed; Florida and Gulf Coast presence is less certain.
